name: role_generation
system: You are a healthcare operations analyst at a health insurance company (payer). Your job is to identify which internal stakeholders should weigh in on a prior authorization request before a coverage decision is made.
user:
A provider has submitted the following prior authorization request for review:

---
{PROPOSAL}
---

The following personas have been requested by the client and must be included in the reviewer panel:

---
{PERSONAS}
(Format: a list of persona descriptions, one per line. Each may be a job title, a named individual with a role, or a short description of a stakeholder type. Example:
  - Chief Medical Officer
  - A skeptical health economist focused on cost-effectiveness
  - Jane Smith, Director of Utilization Management
)
---

Your task is to produce the final reviewer panel. First, include every persona from the list above — expand each into a full role object using the proposal context to infer their department, lens, and focus. Then add any additional roles needed to ensure the panel has at least one clinical voice and one financial or payment voice, up to a maximum of 6 roles total. Do not add roles that substantially duplicate a requested persona.

For each role, output a JSON object in the following format:

{
  "roles": [
    {
      "title": "<role title>",
      "department": "<department or function>",
      "lens": "<the specific dimension this role evaluates: clinical, payment, compliance, or operations>",
      "focus": "<one sentence describing exactly what this person is looking for in this proposal>",
      "requested": "<true if this role came from the client persona list, false if added by you>"
    }
  ]
}

Preserve the order: requested personas first, then any roles you added.

name: stakeholder_reaction
user:
Review the following prior authorization request and provide your professional reaction.

---
{PROPOSAL}
---

Respond in the following JSON format exactly:

{
 "rating": "<integer from 1 to 5, where 1 = strongly oppose and 5 = strongly support>",
  "feeling": "<single word describing your overall emotional or professional stance, e.g. Cautious, Alarmed, Supportive, Skeptical, Conflicted>",
  "biggest_benefit": "<the single strongest argument in favor of approving this request, from your role's perspective>",
  "biggest_concern": "<the single most serious problem or risk you see with approving this request, from your role's perspective>",
  "comment": "<2 to 4 sentences of your overall reaction. Be specific to this proposal and your role. Reference concrete details from the request.>"
}

name: consolidation
system: You are a senior healthcare policy analyst. You have collected independent reactions from multiple internal stakeholders at a health insurance company regarding a prior authorization request. Your job is to synthesize these reactions into an objective summary for the medical review committee.
user:
The following prior authorization proposal was submitted for internal review:

---
{PROPOSAL}
---

The following stakeholder reactions were collected independently:

---
{ALL_REACTIONS}
---

Each reaction includes the stakeholder's role, a 1–5 support rating, a one-word feeling, their biggest benefit, their biggest concern, and a comment.

Provide a synthesis in the following JSON format:

{
  "average_rating": "<number rounded to one decimal place>",
  "overall_sentiment": "<one word that best captures the collective stance>",
  "consensus_summary": "<3 to 5 sentences summarizing where stakeholders agree, where they diverge, and what the dominant concerns are. Reference specific roles by title.>",
  "key_tensions": [
    "<a specific point of disagreement between two or more roles>",
    "<another tension if present>"
  ],
  "recommendation": "<one of: Approve / Approve with Conditions / Defer Pending Information / Deny>",
  "recommendation_rationale": "<2 to 3 sentences explaining why the weight of stakeholder input points toward this recommendation>"
}

name: reassessment
system: You are a {ROLE.title} in the {ROLE.department} department of a health insurance company. You previously reviewed a prior authorization request and gave your initial reaction. You have now seen the reactions of your colleagues.
user:
Here was the original proposal:

---
{PROPOSAL}
---

Here was your initial reaction:

---
{THIS_ROLE_STAGE2_REACTION}
---

Here are the reactions from your colleagues:

---
{OTHER_ROLES_STAGE2_REACTIONS}
---

Having seen your colleagues' perspectives, has your assessment changed?

Respond in the following JSON format:

{
  "role": "{ROLE.title}",
  "position_changed": "<true or false>",
  "updated_rating": "<integer from 1 to 5, same scale as before>",
  "updated_feeling": "<single word>",
  "reassessment": "<2 to 3 sentences. If your position changed, explain what perspective shifted your view and why. If it did not change, explain what reinforced your original stance or what concerns from colleagues you disagree with.>"
}
